:::{#exm-n-gram-model}
#### The sticky coin is a 2-gram model
<!-- no-figure: the example is a short argument with no data to plot -->

In the [sticky coin](#exm-stationary-sequence),
given all the earlier tosses,
$X_t$ repeats $X_{t-1}$ with [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) $0.9$.
That [conditional probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-conditional-prob) involves only the one toss just before $X_t$,
so the sticky coin is a 2-gram model (@def-n-gram-model).

:::
